playback.title: Playback
playback.note: These settings belong to this profile and sync to your other devices.
playback.audioLanguagesHint: Which audio track plays, in order of preference
playback.audioLanguagesExplanation: A video plays in the first of these languages it has. With none chosen, it plays its default audio track.
playback.subtitleLanguagesHint: Which subtitles turn on, in order of preference
playback.subtitleLanguagesExplanation: Subtitles in the first of these languages a video has turn on. With none chosen, subtitles stay off unless the video forces them.
playback.secondSubtitleLanguageHint: Shown at the top of the picture with the first

playback.showSubtitlesHint: Always: subtitles in the spoken language too, SDH first
playback.watchedThresholdHint: How far into a video it counts as watched and Continue Watching moves to the next episode
playback.bingeWatchingHint: When an episode ends, start the next one, from the same source where possible
playback.upNextCountdownHint: How long the next episode prompt waits before starting it
playback.seekShortHint: Arrow keys, the remote and the player's skip buttons
playback.seekLongHint: Shift with the arrow keys, and long presses
playback.videoClickHint: A double click still enters and leaves full screen

skipping.footer: Intros, recaps and credits are found by the names of a video's chapters, so only videos with named chapters offer to skip them. An automatic skip counts down on the button first, and anything you do on the player stops it.
skipping.recapsHint: "Previously on…" at the start of an episode
skipping.creditsHint: End credits and next-episode previews; the next episode's prompt starts with them

streams.footer: The filters apply to every stream list, which says how many streams they hide and can show them anyway.
streams.autoPlayHint: Skips the stream list for Play, Resume, an episode and the next episode; with a sort, it waits until every addon has answered
streams.suggestionsHint: Learns which streams you pick on this profile and marks one in the list
streams.autoPlayFirstMatch: First stream that passes the filters
streams.autoPlayReuseLastLink: Same stream as last time, else the first that passes
streams.qualitiesHint: Which resolutions the stream lists show
streams.rangesHint: Which of SDR, HDR and Dolby Vision the stream lists show
streams.codecsHint: Which video codecs the stream lists show
streams.minSizeHint: Hides streams of smaller files; one that names no size stays
streams.maxSizeHint: Hides streams of larger files; one that names no size stays
streams.includePatternHint: A regular expression, matched against each stream's name, description and file name, ignoring case
streams.invalidPattern: Not a valid regular expression, so it's ignored

device.title: This device
device.note: These settings apply to this device only and don't sync.
device.hardwareDecodingHint: Decode video with the graphics hardware. Turn it off if videos show glitches.
device.hdrHint: Play HDR video in HDR when the display supports it. Off converts it to SDR.
device.matchFrameRateHint: Switch the display to the video's frame rate even where the system wouldn't. The screen goes black for a moment at each switch.
device.audioPassthroughHint: Send surround sound (Dolby Digital, DTS, TrueHD) to the receiver undecoded
device.audioPassthroughHintApple: Send Dolby Digital and Dolby Digital Plus, Atmos included, to the system's Dolby decoder; DTS and TrueHD play as multichannel PCM. Turn off if there's no sound.
device.audioPassthroughHintAppleSpatial: Send Dolby Digital and Dolby Digital Plus, Atmos included, to the system's Dolby decoder, and play TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X as spatial audio; other DTS and TrueHD tracks play as multichannel PCM. Turn off if there's no sound.
device.audioPassthroughNormalized: Off while loudness normalization is on
device.swipeGesturesHint: Swipe up or down on the left half of the video for brightness, on the right half for volume.
device.cacheSizeHint: How much of a stream is loaded ahead of playback
device.discordPresenceHint: Your Discord friends see the title and episode while a video plays. Discord must be running on this computer.
device.crashReportsHint: Send what went wrong when the app crashes or part of it fails, never your addon links or accounts

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.note: These settings apply to this device only and don't sync. They style plain-text subtitles, such as SRT; styled subtitles keep their own look unless you apply the style to them too.
subtitles.backgroundHint: A box behind the text, and how opaque it is
subtitles.positionHint: How far above the bottom of the picture subtitles sit
subtitles.styledOverrideHint: ASS and SSA subtitles take this style instead of their own. Signs and effects can look wrong.
